articles.title: Japan's ruling party supports crypto ETF trading, yen-based stablecoins
articles.snippet: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party said the country should create a legal framework for trading crypto ETFs in a proposal to the finance minister.

articles.title: Citi predicts the tokenized securities market will grow to $5.5 trillion by 2030
articles.snippet: Stablecoins alone will generate a demand for up to $1 trillion worth of onchain U.S. Treasury bills and $2.6 trillion for tokenized stocks, said Citi.

articles.title: Japan’s ruling party pushes crypto ETFs, yen-denominated stablecoins
articles.snippet: The Parliamentary Association for the Promotion of Blockchain delivered recommendations to Japan’s finance minister on crypto and blockchain.

articles.title: ECB official says stablecoins risk importing old market flaws
articles.snippet: ECB board member Isabel Schnabel warned that stablecoins could bring money-market risks into tokenized finance and reinforce US dollar dominance.

articles.title: US, UK central bankers offer contrary views on stablecoins
articles.snippet: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told a conference on Sunday that stablecoins expand the reach of US policy while the Bank of England’s Megan Greene expects their popularity will soon fade.
